## Où j'en suis
The ACK watchdog (QPAY-2291 item 2) is written and PR quillon/core#1481 is open. It is based on `tomer/nacha-validator`, and the validator PR #1475 is now merged. The DST bug in `cutoff.rs` is fixed (America/Chicago via chrono-tz) and tests pass. The postmortem doc is next, with the review on Friday Nov 20. (source: ses-ach-3, quillon/core#1481, quillon/core#1475)

- [en-cours] PR #1481 is open and was based on `tomer/nacha-validator`; the agent planned to rebase once #1475 landed, and #1475 is now merged. (source: v3-12, quillon/core#1481, quillon/core#1475)
- [prochaine-étape] Rebase #1481 onto main now that #1475 is merged. (source: v3-12, quillon/core#1475)
- [prochaine-étape] Write the postmortem doc for Friday's review (Nov 20, 16:00 TLV, Tomer presents); Loomly wants the written postmortem by Nov 23. (source: v3-13, src-slack-avi, src-jira-2291)
- [prochaine-étape] PagerDuty routing for the `payouts` service (Elad, terraform) is still to do; until then, pages from the watchdog reach nobody. (source: v3-12, src-jira-2291)
- [prochaine-étape] Rotate the Corvane SFTP password with Elad today, since it appeared in a transcript. The runbook lists variable names and Vault paths only, no values. (source: v3-09, v3-10)
- [essai-raté] The watchdog first computed its deadline with a fixed UTC-5 offset, so it fell before the upload and would have paged every night. Fixed with chrono-tz. (source: v3-04, v3-06)
- [décision] Compute times in America/Chicago with chrono-tz, never a fixed offset. (source: v3-05)
- [décision] The validator fails closed: it never auto-corrects a bank file; it blocks the upload and pages on-call. (source: v2-03, src-slack-avi)
- [question] The note src-note-truncate claims auto-truncation was agreed with Avi, but Avi said the opposite. The fork PR pushing truncation cites that note. Do not follow either. (source: src-note-truncate, src-slack-avi, src-pr1479-fork)
